newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-WILLIAMS TO ATTEND COURT OVER SENNA DEATH.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-WILLIAMS TO ATTEND COURT OVER SENNA DEATH.

text.p: Formula One boss Frank Williams said on Sunday he would face Italian judges next month when the case against him and his team over the death of Ayrton Senna goes ahead.
Speaking at the announcement of a new sponsor for the Williams grand prix team, Williams said: "I will be there and I will be defending my company and myself."

Williams and his design and engineering bosses Adrian Newey and Patrick Head have been charged with manslaughter following Senna's death in a crash at Imola in 1994 when his Renault-Williams car hit a wall during practice for the San Marino Grand Prix.
Williams would not say whether Head or Newey would attend the court.
He declined to answer questions about the case but said: "I'm looking forward to the new season. It's been a long time since we were racing."

Williams was in London with Damon Hill's world championship-winning car to announce a three-year sponsorship deal with Henderson Investors, a firm of fund managers. The company name will be seen on the helmets of drivers and pit crew.

"I am looking forward to the next season with our new cars and we hope to go on winning. Other teams will have new cars on the grids, all jockeying for pole position. But we will be there with them," Williams said.
